teams.heading: Jake White delays final Fiji squad naming to assess players in Lyon
teams.body: Kali Sewabu, Fiji Rugby's chief executive, told SUNsports that White wants a further three days to watch the squad in Lyon before deciding. White and roughly 10 players from the Japan match flew straight to Lyon, where Europe-based men including Pita Gus Sowakula, Josua Tuisova and Jiuta Wainiqolo joined them for a three-day camp. Sewabu said limited preparation time is Fiji's usual barrier, and the group regroups in Lyon after this weekend's club fixtures, depending on injuries.

lead.why: It is the only Fiji-side item in the pack with a named union official, a concrete squad-selection process and a clear decision still pending.

teams.heading: Alex Mitchell limps off with suspected hamstring pull, major doubt for Australia
teams.body: England's scrum-half problems deepened at Franklin's Gardens, where Alex Mitchell limped off in Northampton's 28-14 win over Gloucester with what looked like another hamstring problem. It is his fourth hamstring injury of the year, after setbacks at an England camp in May and in the summer Test against Fiji. Archie McParland, his Northampton team-mate, was left out of the matchday squad with a calf injury picked up at England's camp. That leaves Borthwick's options thinner at No 9 before the autumn opener against Australia.

lead.why: A fresh England injury concern at scrum-half, with a second England player flagged, ahead of the Australia test.

teams.heading: France's brief reign at world No. 1 lasted just one week
teams.body: France's longest unbroken spell at the top of the world rankings lasted one week, running from July 2022 to July 2022. Both ends of that run fall in the same month, so it was a brief stint at No. 1 rather than a sustained stay. The figure is the benchmark the app holds for the side's time at the summit, and it is a reminder of how quickly the top of the table can change hands.

teams.heading: Ireland say Sam Prendergast is 'optimistic' to face Argentina after wrist injury
teams.body: Sam Prendergast has stepped up his training in recent days, with assistant coach Paul O'Connell confirming the out-half has been jumping in and out of non-contact and close-to-full-contact sessions. "I'm not 100% sure, but he looks like he could be OK," O'Connell said. The wrist injury came last month, and Prendergast appears to be the only injury concern, with Jimmy O'Brien back in full training after a concussion. Management's update says they are "optimistic" he will be available for selection.

teams.heading: Quesada names Italy squad to face South Africa in Turin
teams.body: The Federazione has published Italy's squad for Saturday's Test in Turin, the 19th meeting between the two nations. South Africa have won 18 of those, Italy's sole success a 20-18 win in Florence in 2016, and the Springboks name their own team on Monday evening, South African time. Italy come in off a 10-57 defeat by Australia and have lost all three matches so far this campaign.

teams.heading: Ex-Scotland winger Tim Visser pleads not guilty to charges spanning 14 years
teams.body: Earlier reports said former Harlequins and Scotland player Tim Visser was to go on trial charged with rape. Reports now say he has entered a not guilty plea to abuse charges spanning 14 years, and the case is still before the court. No verdict has been reported, and the case stays open until one is reached. Visser is entitled to the presumption of innocence.

teams.heading: Cardiff beat Ospreys 26-0 in Welsh derby, Tom Bowen scoring twice
teams.body: Ospreys were kept off the scoresheet for the first time in over two years, a red-zone defensive effort that shaped Saturday's derby at St Helen's. Steff Emanuel was involved in all three first-half tries, and Tom Howe's late try at the back of the maul secured the bonus point. Despite several visits to the Cardiff 22, the hosts were unable to find a way back, and the win lifts Cardiff above the Ospreys into the top eight of the URC.

teams.heading: Pumas' opponents 'optimistic' Sam Prendergast will be fit for opener
teams.body: Sam Prendergast appears to be winning his fitness race, with Ireland assistant coach Paul O'Connell saying management are 'optimistic' the out-half will be available. The 23-year-old, who picked up a wrist injury before Leinster's interpro with Munster last month, has stepped up his training, and O'Connell said: 'So, I'm not 100% sure, but he looks like he could be OK.' Prendergast appears to be Ireland's only injury concern, with Jimmy O'Brien back in full training after a concussion, so Argentina may face a near-full-strength side at the Aviva Stadium.

teams.heading: Bledisloe debutant McLaughlin-Phillips leads Australia A to 52-0 win over USA
teams.body: Australia A completed a clean sweep of the USA in New Jersey, after a thumping opener in Nashville. McLaughlin-Phillips led the way, scoring a try, setting up at least three others and finishing with 17 points. Mac Grealy, name-dropped by Les Kiss over the weekend, was one of several backs with five-pointers, while Nick Frost, Will Harris and Toby Macpherson stole four lineouts in the first half. The hosts were 33-0 down at the break.

teams.heading: Suntory reportedly show interest in Damian Willemse as Stormers push for extension
teams.body: Suntory Sungoliath are reportedly tracking Damian Willemse, who is in the final year of his Stormers deal. According to Rapport, the Stormers are fighting to keep the Springbok full-back, with a source saying talks have "already started the extension process". Suntory are "showing great interest" and are reportedly willing to pay big money, and the Tokyo club already has Sam Cane and James Lowe on its books.

teams.heading: Scott Barrett moves on from losing All Blacks captaincy to Ardie Savea
teams.body: Barrett captained the All Blacks under Robertson before the role went to Ardie Savea under Dave Rennie. He told Sky Sport NZ he took inspiration from Kane Williamson, the former Black Caps captain who stepped away from leadership and kept playing. "I reflected on other athletes who had once been captain and then sort of moved on." Rennie called Barrett a reluctant captain, and Barrett missed the whole Super Rugby Pacific season injured before joining the touring squad for November.

lead.why: A new, national-team story about a current All Blacks lock and the captaincy handover, with direct quotes from Barrett.

teams.heading: Stormers open Damian Willemse extension talks as Suntory show interest
teams.body: Willemse is in the final year of the five-year deal he signed with the Stormers in 2022. Rapport reports the club has "already started the extension process" with "broad principles and amounts agreed", but Japan's Suntory Sungoliath are "showing great interest" and are said to be willing to spend "a lot of yen". The report suggests the full-back could still be tempted to Tokyo after the 2027 World Cup, while the Bulls are separately trying to keep Handre Pollard.
